title: epiq belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: ljtn/epiq. CLI based issue tracker TUI - distributed and backed by git. It has about 96 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.
